categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end titanium and titanium alloy materials, including titanium alloy bars, forgings, and components. Its products mainly serve high-end equipment sectors such as aerospace, aviation, ships, and weaponry. The company also extends its product line to downstream components, focusing on marine and civilian aviation markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced metallurgical technologies including controlled directional solidification of titanium alloy ingots, high-strength and high-toughness titanium alloy casting and forging, and precise heat treatment processes. It has developed proprietary technologies for large-size titanium alloy ring materials, wide forging blanks, and high-efficiency preparation of titanium alloy bars and forgings. The production process includes mixing, smelting, forging (free forging), and precision forging, with core processes independently controlled by the company.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major national aerospace and defense groups such as Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China Aero Engine Corporation, China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation, and China North Industries Group. The company serves the aerospace, aviation, marine, and defense sectors, supplying critical titanium alloy materials for new aircraft, engines, ships, and weapon systems. It also targets civilian aviation and marine equipment markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Changde Economic and Technological Development Zone, Hunan Province. Its sales are mainly domestic, serving national strategic industries, with gradual expansion into international aerospace markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the titanium alloy supply chain, focusing on producing titanium alloy raw materials such as bars, forgings, and intermediate products. It also extends downstream into manufacturing titanium alloy components for marine and defense applications, positioning itself as a key materials supplier and partial component manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on serving national strategic needs by developing high-performance titanium alloys for aerospace and defense. R&D priorities include high-temperature, high-strength, and corrosion-resistant titanium alloys, cost-effective alloy production, and advanced manufacturing technologies. The company invests heavily in innovation platforms, patent development, and industry standards formulation, aiming to enhance product performance and expand applications in aerospace, marine, and civilian aviation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of titanium and titanium alloy products, including bars, forgings, and components. The company sells mainly to large industrial customers under long-term contracts following rigorous qualification and certification processes. Revenue recognition occurs upon product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic producers of high-end titanium alloys, competing with major players such as Western Superconducting Technologies and BaoTi Co., Ltd. It holds approximately 7.9% market share in the domestic aerospace titanium alloy market. The industry is highly concentrated with high technical barriers, and the company leverages its technological and market advantages to maintain a strong competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 808 million, a 0.91% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 152 million, up 3.04%. Total assets reached RMB 3.37 billion, growing 27.24%, and shareholders' equity increased 43.55% to RMB 2.44 billion. The company successfully completed its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market in November 2024, raising significant capital to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high product quality, and stable supply capabilities tailored to stringent aerospace and defense requirements. It offers differentiated high-strength, high-toughness titanium alloys with superior performance and cost advantages, supporting critical national strategic equipment. Its comprehensive certifications, strong R&D platforms, and long-term customer relationships provide competitive differentiation and reliability.
